name: Strong Goldbach conjecture
question: Is every even integer greater than 2 a sum of two primes?
first_attack: Audit precise statement and prove a restricted case
dispatch_next: The certified mine goldbach_growth lists the 12 record least primes through 20,000; the largest is 173 at n = 7426. Test an explicit upper bound against those 12 pairs. Do not extend the range toward the published 4*10^18 verification.
dispatch_why: The goldbach_growth mine already lists the record least primes through 20,000. A longer verified range cannot compete with the published 4*10^18 check.

campaign.hypothesis: Every even integer n >= 4 is a sum of two primes.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: State a restricted, checkable lemma (for example an explicit bound on the least Goldbach prime in a named residue class or range) that is not already implied by the 4*10^18 verification or by the ternary Goldbach theorem.
campaign.next_experiment: The certified mine goldbach_growth lists the 12 record least primes through 20,000; the largest is 173 at n = 7426. Test an explicit upper bound against those 12 pairs. Do not extend the range toward the published 4*10^18 verification.
campaign.falsification: An even n >= 4 with no prime p <= n/2 such that n - p is prime, confirmed by an independent primality oracle.
campaign.blocker: Range extension cannot compete with the published 4*10^18 verification; real progress needs a new restricted theorem.

probes.name: Strong Goldbach conjecture
probes.title: Goldbach partitions for every even integer up to N
probes.frontier: Known: verified for every even n <= 4*10^18 (Oliveira e Silva, Herzog & Pardi, Math. Comp. 83 (2014)). This range reproduces known mathematics only.

smoke.scope: Every even integer 4 <= n <= 200,000 is p + q with p, q prime.

deep.scope: Every even integer 4 <= n <= 4,000,000 is p + q with p, q prime.

milestones.title: Goldbach partitions certified for every even n <= 200,000
milestones.scope: Finite range only; far inside the published 4*10^18 verification
milestones.description: Least Goldbach prime recorded for all 99,999 even n in [4, 200000], each re-checked by deterministic Miller-Rabin; the deep run extends to 4*10^6 (record least prime 751 at n = 3,807,404).

milestones.title: Record least Goldbach primes through 20,000
milestones.scope: Finite table inside the published 4*10^18 verification; not a new bound
milestones.description: Twelve running-maximum least primes, the largest 173 at n = 7426. An independent odd-only sieve recomputes the same record list.

formal_statement.encodes: Every even n ≥ 4 is p + (n − p) with both prime; primes by trial division.
not_encoded: Bounds on the least Goldbach prime

kernel_checked.claim: The statement holds for every even 4 ≤ n ≤ 100 (least-prime witness table re-checked by the kernel; the lab covers far larger ranges in Python).
